title: Hold the annual investor update
summary: Walk investors through the year's results and the plan, and answer questions on the record.
outlineSteps: Set the date and send the invitation
Prepare the year's results against plan
Present occupancy, tenant credit and the lease term ahead
Show returns to date and how much still depends on the sale
Restate the hold and exit view for each property
Review with counsel what can be said about future plans
Prepare answers to the questions investors are likely to ask
Hold the meeting and take questions on the record
Send the materials and the answers afterward
Record follow-up items and who owns each one
